name: Commerce Shipping PO Box Condition
description: provides a condition to include/exclude shipping methods when an address is a PO Box or Highway Contract Box.
project_description:
Provides a condition for including or excluding shipping methods if an address contains a Post Office Box.

Useful for only offering postal services for PO Box addresses.

Can also be used to exclude carriers that don't ship to PO Boxes.

 Features 
 Checks the shipping address line for a PO Box or Highway Contract Box.

Can be used to to include or exclude a shipping method from being shown to customers.

 Usage 
 Use like any other shipping condition. Located at Condition -> Customer -> Shipping PO Box section of the shipping method configuration.

Checking the box enables the condition, causing the current shipping method to be shown to the customer if the shipping address contains a PO Box or Highway Contract Box.

Check the Negate box to flip the logic which will exclude the current shipping method from being shown if it contains a PO or HC Box.
